contribution_types.label: UNKNOWN: no contribution-type taxonomy published for the ICML 2026 main track
contribution_types.scope: The main track publishes no contribution categories; position papers are a separate submission type handled by a separate call.
contribution_types.quote: Similar to last year, we also invite submissions of position papers.

review_criteria.name: Soundness
review_criteria.official_explanation: Technical soundness, support for claims, and correctness of proofs and experiments.
review_criteria.quote: Is the submission technically sound? Are claims well supported (e.g., by theoretical analysis or experimental results)?

review_criteria.name: Presentation
review_criteria.official_explanation: Clear, well-structured writing and proper positioning against prior and concurrent literature.
review_criteria.quote: Is the submission clearly written and well structured?

review_criteria.name: Significance
review_criteria.official_explanation: Importance and relevance of the problem and the paper’s potential influence.
review_criteria.quote: Does the paper address an important or relevant problem?

review_criteria.name: Originality
review_criteria.official_explanation: New insights or understanding; originality may come from novel combinations or evaluations.
review_criteria.quote: Does the work provide new insights, deepen understanding, or highlight important properties of existing methods?

review_criteria.name: Reproducibility
review_criteria.official_explanation: Claims must be supported by reproducible experiments or sound theoretical analysis.
review_criteria.quote: All claims must be clearly stated and supported by reproducible experiments and/or sound theoretical analysis.

review_criteria.name: Limitations and Societal Impact
review_criteria.official_explanation: Reviewers assess whether limitations and potential negative societal impact are discussed.
review_criteria.quote: Have the authors adequately discussed the limitations and potential negative societal impact of their work?

review_criteria.name: Submission Compliance
review_criteria.official_explanation: Papers not conforming to ICML submission policies are rejected without review.
review_criteria.quote: Submitted papers that do not conform to these policies will be rejected without review.

mandatory_policy.statement: The main paper is limited to eight pages, with unlimited references, impact statement and appendices.
mandatory_policy.quote: 8 pages for the main paper, with unlimited pages for references, the impact statement, and appendices.

mandatory_policy.statement: All submissions must be anonymized and must not violate double-blind reviewing.
mandatory_policy.quote: All submissions must be anonymized and may not contain any information with the intention or consequence of violating the double-blind reviewing policy.

mandatory_policy.statement: Every submission must have at least one author who agrees to serve as a reviewer for ICML.
mandatory_policy.quote: All submissions must have at least one author who agrees to serve as a reviewer for ICML.

mandatory_policy.statement: Authors must include a broader-impact statement covering ethical aspects and societal consequences.
mandatory_policy.quote: Authors are required to include a statement of the potential broader impact of their work, including its ethical aspects and future societal consequences.

mandatory_policy.statement: Prompt injection aimed at manipulating LLM-assisted review is forbidden and results in desk rejection.
mandatory_policy.quote: Any attempts at prompt injection are strictly forbidden and will result in desk rejection.

recommended_practice.statement: Authors are encouraged to submit code to foster reproducibility, and availability of code is weighed in decisions.
recommended_practice.quote: Authors are encouraged to submit code to foster reproducibility.

recommended_practice.statement: Authors are encouraged to explain notable ways generative-AI tools were used in the research methodology.
recommended_practice.quote: We encourage authors to explain any notable ways in which these tools were used in their research methodology.

recommended_practice.statement: Reviews should be constructive, professional and respectful because they may be made public.
recommended_practice.quote: Reviews should therefore be constructive, professional, and respectful.

compliance_checks.requirement: Main body is at most eight pages (nine in camera-ready).
Submission uses the required ICML LaTeX style files and format.
No author-identifying information anywhere, including supplementary material.
A separate broader-impact section is present before references.
Accepted papers supply a lay (plain-language) summary at camera-ready.
No identical or substantially similar work under parallel review.

changes_from_prior_year.change: Attendance for authors of accepted papers became optional, with proceedings-only publication permitted.
ICML 2026 publishes the originally submitted version and reviews alongside the camera-ready for accepted papers.
ICML 2026 introduced a new two-policy (A/B) framework for LLM use in reviewing.
A person may be the designated reciprocal reviewer for at most two of their submissions.
ICML 2026 newly asks authors to disclose financial conflicts of interest in the camera-ready version.

unknown_policies.reason: Those pages were not captured as 2026 sources, so only the references to them are quoted.

unknown_policies.reason: Position papers are handled by a separate call that was not captured; the main-track sources do not settle it.
